create_trainmodel_actor: create a Ray actor that wraps a Hugging Face training model on a dedicated GPU
run_weight_transfer_nccl: run NCCL-based weight transfer from a training model to a vLLM inference engine

init_weight_transfer_group: initialize an NCCL process group for distributed weight synchronization between trainer and inference engine
